label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. The national database records a past accident inside the area, which the criteria make a clearance target after the first visit; the survey team also observed a field left unused for years, indirect evidence that is a target. Technical survey is unavailable under the programme. The zone flag and priority were not treated as evidence.
flags: The accident record has no date or other detail, and its location has not been checked on the ground.
The observed unused field is in part of the area; the surrounding land is farmed.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: Unchecked database record with no location verification on the ground is weaker indirect evidence under the desk-study rule.

E2.quote: a field in part of the area has been left unused for years, with collapsed fences and overgrown paths, although the land around it is farmed.
E2.note: The survey team directly observed potentially productive land left unused; this suggests possible EO and is not evidence of safe use or absence.
